requirement: Consequential archival/source records require stable identity independent of project role, title shorthand and file instance.
information_needed: stable source key; archive/fonds/signature/record identity; title/locus attributes
failure_or_risk: Distinct records could collapse or one source could acquire contradictory identities.
validation_mode: deterministic referential checks + archival judgement for identity
specialist_trigger: when archival identity itself is disputed or consequential
architecture_handoff: no change demonstrated

requirement: Provenance/context must remain distinguishable from the record itself and later research interpretation.
information_needed: repository/archive; fonds/series/signature context; record identity; event/agent/context claims
current_support: adequate for current corpus; scale risk
failure_or_risk: Flattened context would make provenance/administrative relations indistinguishable from source identity.
validation_mode: archival judgement + deterministic presence/integrity where structured
specialist_trigger: when arrangement/provenance interpretation carries a consequential historical claim
architecture_handoff: future trigger only; no hierarchy refactor now

requirement: The exact inspected instantiation must remain distinct from the archival/intellectual record.
information_needed: file ID; source ID; filename; checksum; coverage; preservation/storage/rights state
failure_or_risk: A portal representation or later export could change while claims still refer to an earlier byte sequence.
validation_mode: deterministic checksum/referential checks; human authority for rights facts where needed
specialist_trigger: when file identity or preservation status is disputed
architecture_handoff: no change demonstrated

requirement: Archival folio/locus, portal/export image, PDF page and working identifiers must remain separate mappings with evidence status.
information_needed: identifier type/value; mapping basis/status
failure_or_risk: Numeric coincidence could create false archival addressing.
validation_mode: deterministic uniqueness/integrity + archival/source inspection for mapping
specialist_trigger: when locus mapping is consequential or disputed
architecture_handoff: coordinate with canonical locus addressing

requirement: Catalogue/finding-aid assertions, archival inference and direct inspection must be distinguishable.
information_needed: evidence/access level; status; inspected unit; limitations
failure_or_risk: Metadata could be promoted to observed source fact or textual relation.
specialist_trigger: when metadata/inference materially affects a consequential claim
architecture_handoff: no change demonstrated

requirement: Source relationships must be evidence-bearing claims, not identity shortcuts.
evidence_basis: ICA RiC concepts + source criticism + #26 audit
information_needed: subject; predicate; object; status; evidence basis; limitations
failure_or_risk: Extract/copy/parallel/common-event relations could be mistaken for demonstrated textual dependence.
specialist_trigger: when transmission/dependence becomes consequential
architecture_handoff: use canonical typed locus references for locus-level relations

requirement: Research function is project-relative and must not become an absolute source property.
information_needed: project + source -> role/function + relevant locus
failure_or_risk: A source could be wrongly frozen as principal/control/context across all projects.
specialist_trigger: when project role itself is contested
architecture_handoff: no change demonstrated

requirement: Completeness/absence claims require documented search/access boundaries; lack of inspection must not become absence.
information_needed: repositories/catalogues searched; bounds; queries/filters; access limits; exclusions; unavailable material
current_support: adequate as method; not currently instantiated
failure_or_risk: Accumulated examples could be mistaken for a complete corpus.
validation_mode: human/research audit when completeness is asserted
specialist_trigger: when a completeness/absence claim is made
architecture_handoff: no action until such claims exist

requirement: Consequential loci used as relation endpoints or claim targets need an unambiguous canonical address, not an ad-hoc string convention.
information_needed: source identity + canonical/typed locus reference
failure_or_risk: Human-readable source:locus strings cannot be referentially validated or reliably migrated.
validation_mode: deterministic referential validation after target representation is chosen
specialist_trigger: when a consequential relation/claim targets a locus
architecture_handoff: candidate data-model + validator requirement; coordinate across domains

requirement: Documentary form/genre and record stage/status must be distinguishable where stage is consequential.
information_needed: documentary form; record stage/type-of-representation; evidential basis
failure_or_risk: Genre and stage such as extract/copy/draft could be conflated in one field or note.
validation_mode: archival/diplomatic judgement; deterministic vocabulary only after model choice
specialist_trigger: when original/copy/extract/draft status materially affects interpretation
architecture_handoff: candidate targeted semantic split; no wholesale schema rewrite

requirement: Every consequential uncertain sign/grapheme sequence must be localized before lexical completion.
information_needed: canonical source/locus; physical line/span; image provenance; visible partial sequence
failure_or_risk: Whole-word guessing can turn semantic plausibility into manuscript evidence.
validation_mode: structural address validation + scholarly judgement for reading
specialist_trigger: consequential unresolved token after adequate internal comparison
architecture_handoff: requires exact span/locus addressing; reuse ARCH locus solution

requirement: Palaeographic comparison anchors must be exactly recoverable.
information_needed: source ID; folio/line/span; exact inspected instantiation/image reference
failure_or_risk: A reviewer cannot reproduce a graphical comparison from vague page/word references.
validation_mode: deterministic referential check once target model exists
specialist_trigger: any promoted reading relying materially on a comparison anchor
architecture_handoff: candidate anchor/provenance structure; no separate addressing scheme

requirement: Same-record/context and same-hand claims must remain distinct; hand identity is an evidence-bearing hypothesis.
information_needed: hand hypothesis ID/status; evidence loci/features; limitations; named person separately
failure_or_risk: Contextual association can silently become scribal identity and contaminate comparanda.
specialist_trigger: cross-record hand attribution, publication claim, or consequential use of same-hand evidence
architecture_handoff: minimal hand-hypothesis representation only if real work requires it; no global registry yet

requirement: Palaeographic comparison must record discriminating graphical features, not only repeated word forms or silhouettes.
information_needed: candidates; observed discriminating/non-discriminating features; exact anchors; conclusion/status
failure_or_risk: Repeated lexical strings can bias recognition without showing why forms discriminate candidates.
validation_mode: expert judgement with human-auditable evidence record
specialist_trigger: consequential reading promoted because of internal grapheme comparison
architecture_handoff: lean candidate -> features -> anchors -> conclusion trail; no grapheme ontology

requirement: Written sign, abbreviation, editorial expansion, normalization and identification must remain separate.
evidence_basis: TEI representation principles + palaeographic/editorial method + #27 audit
information_needed: written form/sign; phenomenon type; expansion separately; status/evidence
failure_or_risk: Expansion or normalization could overwrite what is actually visible.
validation_mode: structural distinction + scholarly judgement for expansion
specialist_trigger: unusual/consequential abbreviation or unresolved sign system
architecture_handoff: test source-sign vs expansion separation in Knau loss test

requirement: Numerals, currency/measure/accounting notation must be treated as potentially distinct sign systems.
information_needed: sign locus/image; raw sign reading; candidate function/value; comparison class; status; domain context
failure_or_risk: Alphabetic heuristics could misread specialized notation and values.
specialist_trigger: consequential value/measure interpretation or publication
architecture_handoff: targeted notation structures only if recurring evidence requires them

requirement: Alternatives, rejected readings and residual uncertainty must remain traceable.
information_needed: candidate; status; evidence for/against; rejection reason; supersession/decision reference
failure_or_risk: Fluent reconstructions can re-enter and decision history becomes unauditable.
validation_mode: scholarly judgement + deterministic completeness checks where consequential
specialist_trigger: any consequential promoted/rejected reading
architecture_handoff: candidate lean decision/evidence trail

requirement: Consequential visual comparison must trace to the exact source image/derivative used.
information_needed: exact file/image/crop identity; parent/original; transformation if any
failure_or_risk: Crop/scaling/image substitution can affect sign perception and prevent reproducibility.
validation_mode: deterministic provenance validation once representation is chosen
specialist_trigger: when enhanced/cropped/processed imagery materially affects a conclusion
architecture_handoff: attach image/crop provenance only where materially used

requirement: Palaeographic evidence must remain separate from lexical, contextual and historical inference.
information_needed: evidence class per argument/candidate; reading layer separate from normalization/identification
failure_or_risk: Semantic/context knowledge could contaminate grapheme adjudication.
specialist_trigger: when context strongly favors one candidate in a consequential reading
architecture_handoff: preserve evidence-class separation in future claim model

requirement: Unresolved palaeographic questions are valid outcomes and qualified human specialist review must be explicit at high consequence.
information_needed: review status; reviewer role; scope/date; unresolved state
failure_or_risk: AI/self-review could be mistaken for independent validation or uncertainty forced closed.
specialist_trigger: publication or consequential historical claim depends on unresolved/highly specialist reading
architecture_handoff: include explicit review-status capability when trigger occurs

requirement: Diplomatic/graphematic manuscript form must remain primary and separable from lexical interpretation.
information_needed: diplomatic form; separate lexical/interpretive claim path
failure_or_risk: A plausible historical word could silently replace visible signs.
specialist_trigger: when lexical interpretation materially changes a consequential reading
architecture_handoff: no new structure demonstrated beyond preserving layer separation

requirement: Abbreviation sign and editor-provided expansion must remain distinct.
information_needed: written abbreviation/sign; expansion separately; evidence/status
failure_or_risk: Expansion could be falsely presented as manuscript text.
specialist_trigger: unusual or consequential expansion
architecture_handoff: coordinate with REQ-PAL-005 in Knau loss test

requirement: Segmentation/word-boundary uncertainty must be representable independently of lexical candidate.
information_needed: uncertain span; alternative segmentation/word-boundary status
failure_or_risk: A lexical guess could force word division not established by the manuscript.
specialist_trigger: when segmentation affects lexical/morphological interpretation
architecture_handoff: candidate smallest representation for uncertain segmentation

requirement: Historical spelling and morphology must be preserved; normalized forms are derived/search aids only.
information_needed: diplomatic form; optional derived normalization separately
failure_or_risk: Modernization would destroy evidence for language history and scribal usage.
validation_mode: method invariant; deterministic separation if normalization is added
specialist_trigger: when normalized outputs are introduced
architecture_handoff: no action unless normalization becomes an actual requirement

requirement: Lexical/semantic claims must cite the actually inspected dictionary/corpus/article entry or passage.
information_needed: research source; exact entry/passage; access/version; claim link; limitations
failure_or_risk: Linguistic knowledge could act as hidden prompt/model authority and become unauditable.
specialist_trigger: when lexical/semantic evidence materially supports a consequential claim
architecture_handoff: project-local philological evidence/source audit first; bibliography structure only on trigger

requirement: Lexical plausibility may rank/test graphically viable candidates only after manuscript evidence is localized.
information_needed: localized visible sequence; candidate list; lexical evidence kept separate
failure_or_risk: Semantic fluency can manufacture readings.
specialist_trigger: when lexical plausibility drives candidate ranking in a consequential case
architecture_handoff: no new architecture demonstrated

requirement: Historical semantics must be period- and context-sensitive; modern meaning cannot be assumed.
information_needed: period-appropriate lexical/semantic evidence linked to claim
current_support: needs evidence when claims become consequential
failure_or_risk: A correctly read historical form could still be mistranslated or misinterpreted.
specialist_trigger: consequential semantic interpretation or publication
architecture_handoff: project research evidence first; specialist review where needed

requirement: Lexical candidate, normalization and historical identification must carry uncertainty/status distinct from transcription status.
information_needed: separate claim type; status; evidence; target manuscript span/locus
current_support: gap when such claims are created
failure_or_risk: A secure transcription could be paired with uncertain lexical identity or vice versa, but one status would conflate them.
specialist_trigger: when normalization/lexical identification becomes consequential
architecture_handoff: candidate small claim/evidence structure; do not prebuild ontology

requirement: Recurring lexical knowledge should be promoted beyond the project only after demonstrated cross-project reuse.
information_needed: project-local evidence plus explicit reuse trigger
failure_or_risk: A premature corpus lexicon could freeze project-specific readings/generalizations.
specialist_trigger: when repeated cross-project reuse is demonstrated
architecture_handoff: no action now

requirement: Consequential specialist linguistic identifications must expose independent-review status.
information_needed: review status; reviewer role; scope/date
failure_or_risk: AI/method compliance could be mistaken for independent philological validation.
specialist_trigger: publication-level or consequential philological identification
architecture_handoff: include review-status capability when trigger occurs
